sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Muskallonge Lake State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21 alike): 118 20/30-amp sites $37, 41 50-amp sites $42. The DNR's 2026 table: $35 / $40. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($37 / $42 on 2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21; $35 / $40 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Muskallonge campground $40 / $35) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskallonge ('Recreation Passport required'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskallonge (campground tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (148 sites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', all 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 41 with 50 amps), read 2026-10-22

values.note: One modern campground of three sections on the Muskallonge Lake shore, Lake Superior across CR 407. 20/30-amp sites take trailers/RVs to 50 ft; some 50-amp sites are listed for 'Trailer or RV over 50''.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskallonge ('Number of sites: 159'; tag 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com resources (equipment to 'Trailer or RV up to 50'', some 50-amp sites 'Trailer or RV over 50''), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskallonge (campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Sanitation station') + campground map legend ('Restrooms/Shower', 'Water Spigot', 'Sanitation Station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskallonge ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + campground map + booking site + DNR rates table: 159 sites, 20/30 A and 50 A on 41, no water/sewer at sites, pull-throughs, RVs to 50 ft (some 50-amp sites over 50); showers/flush toilets/sanitation station/water spigots; reservable. Fees 35-40 (2026 table) -> 37-42 (2027 booking site; 2026 rates and the Recreation Passport in fees.note). Season (manual) left as is. Pin sits on the campground entrance road off CR 407, ~80 m north of the loops (Esri imagery), close enough. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Website is only the bare reservation home page and the entry has no phone: the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskallonge, phone 906-658-3338.
